Job description

As a Technical Lead, you will lead backend architecture and development for the Compsurance MVP, forming the foundation of a scalable InsurTech ecosystem that includes Quotesurance, Compsurance, and Alpha Automation. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for defining best practices, mentoring the team, and owning all API and infrastructure components.


Roles And Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend APIs and microservices using Python (FastAPI).
  • Define and enforce architecture standards for scalability, security, and compliance (GLBA, SOC 2 ready).
  • Build and manage data pipelines that integrate external APIs (Briza, NCCI, carriers, and CRMs).
  • Lead code reviews, DevOps collaboration, and deployment pipelines (AWS EKS / Aurora / S3 / SES).
  • Implement authentication, RBAC, logging, and monitoring controls.
  • Mentor junior developers and collaborate closely with frontend and DevOps engineers.
  • Document architecture, APIs, and integration flows in GitHub and Postman.

Key Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience working as a full-stack developer
  • 5+ years of experience in Python and 3+ years of experience in ReactJs 
  • 3+ years of experience in AWS (Aurora PostgreSQL, EKS / ECS, S3, SES, CloudFront) 
  • Expertise in FastAPI (or Flask / Django REST), SQLAlchemy, and async programming
  • Experience with hybrid app development or native iOS & Android experience is a plus
  • Expertise with REST API design, integration patterns, and microservice architecture 
  • Prior Familiarity with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation) is mandatory
  • Prior familiarity with security standards and data privacy is mandatory (preferably SOC 2, GLBA, NAIC Model #668)
  • Ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders and convert requirements into technical deliverables.
  • Prior experience in the Insurance or Financial services domain is desirable
  • Prior Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is desirable
  • Familiarity with data analytics and reporting frameworks is desirable
  • Strong communication skills and remote-team leadership experience

About company

Alpha Insurance Solutions is a nationally licensed, independent insurance agency committed to delivering client-first solutions with integrity, transparency, and professionalism. Licensed in 28 states in the US, with over 5,500 clients served, we have built a reputation as a trusted advisor in both personal and commercial lines.

Alpha Insurance Solutions is expanding its digital footprint through a unified suite of InsurTech Alpha applications, including Quotesurance (insurance quote estimation), Compsurance (workers' compensation quote estimation), and future automation tools. InsurTech Alpha was founded with a singular vision: to transform the insurance industry through technology and innovation.
